content: Finally, the input sample of the text mode is a tensor of integers with $T \times l_n \times l_s$ dimensions, where $l_n$ is the maximum number of news occurring in a given day and $l_s$ is the maximum length of a corpus sentence. Regarding the price mode, we have a $T \times 4$ tensor of floating numbers.
